comment: Which committed artifact each content_hash in block-manifest.json pins.
klt signoff compares a manifest pin against the *cited envelope's own*
recorded input hash. Whether it also re-hashes the artifact itself
(citation.input_verified) depends on the envelope kind and on whether the
path the envelope names still resolves -- for every citation below it does
not (the DRC envelope names an absolute path in a since-removed worktree,
the LVS envelope predates provenance.input, and a generic envelope is
never re-hashed), so input_verified is null on all of them and a change
to the artifact would not move the grade.
This file closes that gap: signoff/check_signoff.py re-hashes every path
below and fails when it no longer equals the manifest's pin for that item.
It is stdlib-only and PDK-free, so it runs in the headless CI checks job.
